text: On June 28, 2022 North York Community Council adopted recommendations to poll eligible householders on Ranee Avenue, between Rajah Street and Bathurst Street, to determine whether residents support the installation of traffic calming. The purpose of this motion is to expand the section of Ranee Avenue to be considered for traffic calming.

North York Community Council: 1. Amended Item NY33.36, headed 'Traffic Calming - Ranee Avenue' with respect only to Part 1 of the North York Community Council's decision. 2. Deleted Part 1 of the North York Community Council decision on Item NY33.36 and adopted the following instead: "1. Direct the Director of Traffic Management, Transportation Services, to request the City Clerk to poll eligible householders on Ranee Avenue, between Ameer Avenue and Bathurst Street, to determine whether residents support the installation of traffic calming, in accordance with the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy."
